reviewMethod: Human-style claim-by-claim review by Codex of every accepted synthetic answer against the actual returned cited excerpts, independent of term matching; no LLM judge API.

claims.claim: HTTP 503 was caused by exhausted PostgreSQL connections.
The team reduced the connection pool to 20.
A database restart was not required.
AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED means the access token exceeded expiry.
Obtain a new token through the approved login flow.
Runbook A specifies 10 connections per instance.
Runbook B specifies 20 connections per instance.
The postmortem reports reducing the pool to 20 as part of recovery.

observations: Conflict answer preserves both 10 and 20, does not fabricate authority to resolve the conflict, and cites the postmortem separately.
The direct answer describes the documented remediation causally; no new operational step was introduced.
Source coverage counts the four expected document associations across answerable cases; extra correctly supported database citation in conflict is not penalized.
All five cases completed only after user freed unrelated Docker memory. Earlier five-case and smaller-context failures are preserved separately.
limitations: Three answers, two abstentions and one injection case cannot characterize production quality or prove injection immunity.
No multilingual/production data, concurrent inference load or independent second human judge.
Final historical citation-read tightening was separately regression-tested; the live generation prompt/provider/parser policy are unchanged.
